name: put
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::put(Tensor self, Tensor index, Tensor source, bool accumulate=False) -> Tensor. Writes source into flattened self indices, optionally accumulating duplicates. Tests cover floating, integer, boolean, and complex dtypes; accumulate modes; negative, empty, noncontiguous, and storage-offset inputs; input non-mutation; invalid dtype and length errors; and the shared put.out buffer identity contract.
